title: Fuck Everything 👉👌💦
description:
Your house is full of secrets. Some of them are wearing very interesting shapes.

You ordered an advanced, high-tech companion. A sophisticated piece of technology designed to understand your deepest desires, preferences, and fantasies.

There was just one little issue.

You have no fucking clue what you're into.

Welcome to Fuck Everything 👉👌💦 — a bizarre 3D first-person adventure where everyday objects have personalities, household appliances have secrets, and your furniture might know you better than you know yourself.

The preference scan crashes. Your brand-new companion is confused and has absolutely nothing to work with.
So, naturally, the next logical step is to turn your entire house into a playground for self-discovery.
And that's just the beginning.

 GAME FEATURES
🏠 Explore Your Weird-Ass Home
Roam through a fully explorable 3D house where every room hides unexpected characters, secrets, and encounters.

💬 Meet Your New Fuckmates
Turn everyday objects into unique female characters with their own personalities, dialogue, interests, and questlines.

🔎 Quests, Secrets & Discoveries
Complete multi-stage quests, follow clues, collect stat points, and unlock new interactions as you explore.

 🎮 First-Person Exploration Meets Visual Novel
Explore the world in 3D and interact with its inhabitants through expressive 2D dialogue scenes.

 😂 Expect the Unexpected
Enjoy outrageous conversations, ridiculous situations, bizarre characters, and humor that knows absolutely no boundaries.

🔥 Find Out What You're Into
Discover 10+ kinks, fetishes, and sexual interests through character encounters, choices, and progression.

💦 Unlock Your Wild Side
Meet new characters, uncover their secrets, and see just how far your curiosity can take you. YOUR HOUSE. YOUR RULES. YOUR VERY QUESTIONABLE ADVENTURE.
description_short: Your brand-new AI sex doll asked what you’re into, and you had no fucking clue. Luckily, your home is full of objects that would love to help, from a clingy teddy bear to a bathtub with serious mommy energy. Try more than ten kinks and come back to her knowing exactly what you want.
